climate.ensemble_method: Unweighted mean and min/max across three exact model-year trajectories; not a probability interval.

limitations: Three GCM families and one member each do not span the full CMIP6 uncertainty.
Historical is bias-adjusted historical model output, not an observed present-day measurement.
0.25-degree coastal/island grid cells do not resolve a farm, valley, glacier or water catchment.

Precipitation includes snow water equivalent; it is not runoff, storage or usable agricultural water.
GDD0/GDD5 and frost-free runs are calculated indicators, not locally validated crop thresholds or yields.
18 C heating-degree-days are an explicit reference temperature, not a measured building energy need.
Monthly means are not a coherent actual growing year; daily per-model trajectories are retained.
A selected model year is one realization per model, not a prediction of actual weather in that calendar year. Interannual variability is preserved; consecutive-year changes need not be monotonic.
Single-year screening is not a long-term infrastructure design standard or an expert-approved yield forecast. Multi-year stress tests and local validation remain necessary.

Annual water screening starts with zero snowpack and an empty tank. Snow carried over from the previous year is not represented; this is an explicit initialization assumption, not measured source availability.

treatment.salt_balance_approximation: Equal-density incompressible volume balance with zero-salt permeate; not detailed ion rejection or a brine discharge design
limitations: NDP, pump/ERD efficiencies, auxiliary pretreatment energy and pressure drop are declared design ranges; no selected installed membrane or Arctic pilot exists.

Subzero source water is not extrapolated through a warm-water-only correlation: explicit heating to at least 0°C is required, with freeze protection still unresolved. Only sensible liquid-water heat is included, not sea-ice melting; source liquid phase requires verification.
Manufacturer temperature correction is a permeability sensitivity, not proof of cold-water membrane suitability.
Boron, specific ions, organics, turbidity, fouling, scaling, disinfection, remineralisation/nutrient conditioning and brine permits require laboratory/design work.
Mass salinity g/kg is not Practical Salinity/PSU; no silent conversion is permitted.
Pressure-limit failure is reported, not silently clamped; heat remains separate from electricity.

UAF_GDD_2022.title: University of Alaska Fairbanks IARC, crop heat-unit explanation
UAF_GDD_2022.transfer_limitation: Approximate barley maturity target; cultivar and moisture dependent, not a Svalbard calibrated phenology model.

UAF_HYDROPONIC_2007.title: UAF Agricultural and Forestry Experiment Station 2007 research report
UAF_HYDROPONIC_2007.transfer_limitation: Supports a method precedent, not transferred Arctic energy or yield coefficients.

XU_2026.title: Xu et al. (2026), Northern permafrost represents a limit on the northward shift of climatically feasible agricultural frontiers under future warming
XU_2026.transfer_limitation: MaxEnt climatic suitability is not an agricultural allocation or construction approval. This application does not reproduce their trained models.

provenance.uncertainty: Deterministic bounded reruns; no probability/confidence intervals.
provenance.sensitivity_threshold: SENSITIVE if area reallocation > max(0.01 m²,0.1% area), feasibility changes, harvest or equivalent energy >5%, or desalinated source change >5% total water. Explicit reporting thresholds, not significance tests.
provenance.temperature_approximation: 21/19°C day/night targets, 17h flat light schedule preserving published ramp-integrated DLI. Daily outdoor weather reconstructed hourly, not hourly observation.
provenance.normalization: Single growing layer, 100 m² default; cultivated area != complete facility footprint.
provenance.season_policy: May–September / March–October / annual engineering schedules, not projected natural growing seasons.
provenance.capacity_policy: No local energy/land permit/water right assumed. Optional explicit resource ceilings only.

water_security.source_share_basis: Actual allocated source total; not physical source-water availability.

critical_month.label: Mayıs
critical_month.selection_rule: Largest monthly backup volume; tied volumes use highest backup/demand ratio.
critical_month.meaning: Roof/tank shortfall before backup sources; not an unserved deficit after desalination.

storage.meaning: Selected tank size and simulated occupied volume are different. Neither is a calculated minimum tank size.

backup.aggregation: Min/max across modeled years and models; mean of model annual means. Equal periods required for pooled-mean interpretation.
backup.meaning: Additional water after roof/tank supply, before freshwater/desalination; not measured unreliability.
backup.initial_condition_warning: İlk model yılında boş depo başlangıcı etkisi bulunuyor; bu bir kurak yıl kanıtı değildir.

dry_year_sensitivity.comparison: (Largest modeled annual backup - equal-weight mean annual backup) / mean annual backup.
dry_year_sensitivity.threshold_kind: Explicit display convention, not a physical failure threshold or significance test.
dry_year_sensitivity.interpretation: Highest backup-demand year; not necessarily the lowest-precipitation year.

actions.text: 94,6 m² kontrollü hidroponik üretim; 5,4 m² sera. Ürün alanları: Alabaş 75,0 m², Roka 5,0 m², Fesleğen 5,0 m², Marul 5,0 m², Turp 5,0 m², Pazı 5,0 m². Yerel pilotta verim ve çevrim koşullarını doğrula.

actions.title: Su kaynaklarını bu paylarla hazırla
actions.text: Toplanan yağış / kar erimesi: 14,2 m³ (%100,0). Toplanan suyun kalitesini ve gerekli koşullandırmayı doğrula.
actions.evidence_basis: Monthly LP allocated usable-water volumes, not surveyed source capacity.

actions.title: Mayıs için yedek suyu planla

actions.title: Enerji ve depo kurulumunu doğrula
actions.text: Yıllık ısı gereği 1626 kWh ısıl; ısıtma dönüşümü dışındaki elektrik 117605 kWh; seçilen ısıtma katsayısıyla toplam 119231 kWh elektrik eşdeğeri; hesapta seçilen depo 10,0 m³; minimum depo hesabı yapılmadı. Bunlar enerji miktarlarıdır; cihaz gücü veya mevcut yerel kapasite değildir.
actions.evidence_basis: Calculated annual energy; explicit configured tank and energy ceiling.

actions.title: İlk üretim yılı için yedek suyu hazırla

risk.reporting_rule: SENSITIVE if area reallocation > max(0.01 m²,0.1% area), feasibility changes, harvest or equivalent energy >5%, or desalinated source change >5% total water. Explicit reporting thresholds, not significance tests.

limitations: Üretim ve kaynak gereksinimleri koşullu model sonuçlarıdır; yerel işletme veya yeni saha ölçümü değildir.
Aylık kaynak tahsisi ve günlük çatı/depo sonrası yedek gereksinimi farklı hesaplardır.
Depo kapasitesi optimize edilmedi; seçilen kapasite ve doluluk minimum depo gereksinimi değildir.
Model-yıl aralığı ve gösterim eşikleri olasılık, güven aralığı veya kanıtlanmış başarısızlık eşiği değildir.
